tools.name: get_account
tools.description: The account behind the API key: id, username, email, balance (EUR) and status. Free.

tools.name: get_prices
tools.description: Per-minute call prices and per-part SMS prices in EUR. Give a country (ISO code like GB) for one country; without it you get a compact list of every country. Free.

tools.name: list_sms_routes
tools.description: SMS routes you can send on (route id + name). With a country, each route's price per message part there, cheapest first. Use the id as "route" in send_sms. Free.

tools.name: send_sms
tools.description: Sends one SMS with your sender ID. COSTS MONEY: the route price per part for the destination is taken from the balance. Without "route" the cheapest priced route is used; get route ids and prices from list_sms_routes.

tools.name: make_spoof_call
tools.description: Places a phone call that shows the caller ID you choose. COSTS MONEY: only answered calls are billed, on the destination plan's billing blocks (e.g. 60/60 = any answered call costs at least one minute), plus the recording fee if recorded. Returns a call id for get_call.

tools.name: tts_call
tools.description: Calls a number and speaks your text with a synthetic voice, showing your caller ID. COSTS MONEY: billed per minute like any call. Returns a ref for get_tts_call.

tools.name: get_tts_call
tools.description: Status, duration and cost of a text-to-speech call by its ref. Free.

tools.name: get_call
tools.description: Status of a call by its id (from make_spoof_call, or call_id from tts_call): queued, dialing (waiting for the network), ringing (the phone rings), answered, completed, busy, no_answer, failed or canceled, with ringing_at, post_dial_delay_ms, with duration, billed seconds and cost. Free.

tools.name: list_calls
tools.description: The account's calls, newest first, with status, duration and cost. Free.

tools.name: list_tts_voices
tools.description: Voices available for text-to-speech calls. Free.

tools.name: hlr_quote
tools.description: Checks a list of numbers (format, duplicates) and returns what an HLR lookup of them would cost. Nothing is looked up or charged. Free.

tools.name: hlr_lookup
tools.description: Live network lookup: is each number active, mobile or landline, which network, ported or not. COSTS MONEY: the price per number with a result is held first; numbers without a result are refunded. Up to 100 numbers per call.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_account, list_sms_routes · Private data: get_account · Public sink: get_account, get_prices, list_sms_routes, send_sms · Destructive: hlr_quote.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_account, list_sms_routes · Private data: get_account · Public sink: get_account, get_prices, list_sms_routes, send_sms · Destructive: hlr_quote

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
